run_ovseg_demo: run the open vocabulary segmentation demo on input images with a config file and class names
setup_cfg_from_file: setup a Detectron2 config by merging a YAML config file with command-line options and freezing it
create_argparse_parser: create an argparse parser with arguments for config file, input images, class names, output, and opts
run_visualization_on_image: run the VisualizationDemo on an image with class names and get predictions and visualized output
save_visualized_output: save the visualized segmentation output image to a specified file or directory path
